head_resolution.note: Resolve dev/manager-4.17.10 live. Manager 4.17.9 remains production-installed in single-instance compatibility mode. Manager 4.17.10 g1 is immutable and rejected before qualification because its root PUBLIC_FILE_MANIFEST.json was stale; proceed only through g2 after exact-head revalidation.

materialization.fix: Invoke-Doctor initializes its finding accumulator before every registry-specific Add-DoctorFinding path.

knowledge_closure.runtime_path_proven: disposable Genesis -> InitializeInstanceRegistry -> Doctor -> [OK] inbox.hub_global and [OK] instances.registry

development_validation.note: The previously validated head preceded discovery of stale candidate-bound PUBLIC_FILE_MANIFEST metadata. The repaired/guarded exact head must pass the normal Development Validation, including public manifest reproducibility, before g2 freeze.

candidate_4_17_10_g1.rejection_reason: Frozen root PUBLIC_FILE_MANIFEST.json still identified Manager 4.17.9 and bound 4.17.9 hashes even though manager/product/install/INSTALLATION.json and Manager product bytes identified 4.17.10.

public_manifest_repair.guard: Development validation triggers on PUBLIC_FILE_MANIFEST.json and Build-PublicFileManifest.ps1 and executes Build-PublicFileManifest.ps1 -Check before disposable validation.

historical_non_product_failures.cause: candidate checkout used fetch-depth 1 while immutable-freeze preflight required HEAD^
static assertion expected two backslashes instead of the one-backslash PowerShell path literal
validation recursively counted both issued g1 and nested disposable g9001 gate instead of preferring the artifact-root issued gate like the bootstrap does
post-freeze operational state used a lifecycle_state outside the canonical enum
risk_defect_gate.status temporarily stored observed result instead of the policy marker
one-shot validator incorrectly applied git diff --check to authoritative Manager CRLF/mixed-EOL bytes; product materialization was staged but not committed
first closure-cleanup workflow revision embedded an unindented PowerShell here-string inside YAML block scalar, so GitHub rejected the workflow before job creation

next_exact_goal.description: Require exact-head Development Validation PASS after the canonical 4.17.10 public manifest repair and new fail-closed manifest reproducibility guard. Then freeze Manager 4.17.10 g2 from that exact tree and qualify g2 against production Manager 4.17.9. Do not activate production multi-Hub before qualified 4.17.10 installation.
